verdict.rationale: Termius documents reusable snippets that run on several hosts at once and startup snippets that run on each connection. These are one-off or connection-triggered actions, not a recurring time-based schedule. Nothing in the evidence shows it can schedule recurring jobs or workflows, and a user's own scripts or cron would be a workaround, not product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
